youtube_description:
Went for a quick overnight to test the limit of my warmer weather quilts to see how low I could take them.  Quilts are DIY 2.5 oz climashield quilts I made last year.  Low for the night ended up 43, but I got cold enough to wake up at 47 degrees.  I will likely relegate these quilts to temps of 55 and above.


Also tested loading my new pack from Nashville Packs, but did not get a chance to hike with it.
youtube_title: Testing Quilts on a quick overnite and a quick look at a new pack from Nashville Packs
